name: Marco Barcena
office: City of Bell Gardens, Member of the City Council

items.text: Marco Barcena is a member of the Bell Gardens City Council. He has served as mayor twice. He was first elected in 2018. He graduated from UC Berkeley. Before joining the council, he worked for the city as a lifeguard, pool manager, and administrative specialist.

sentences.text: Marco Barcena is a member of the Bell Gardens City Council.
He has served as mayor twice.
Before joining the council, he worked for the city as a lifeguard, pool manager, and administrative specialist.

items.text: He voted against selling the city's municipal water system. He supported Measure BG, a tax measure for projected deficits. He says he chaired the committee that drafted Southeast Los Angeles' first rent stabilization ordinance. His profile lists priorities including addressing homelessness and improving public safety. He says he helped secure $13.5 million for the Ford Park Aquatics Center. The city council renamed the pool the Dreamers Aquatic Center in 2025.
